Label: Start
Comment: SET: declares reusable cutoff variables and selects the logging Standard. Registrations must name an existing Standard configured under Program -> Registrations - rename 'STANDARD' to match yours.

Label: Charge
Comment: CC_CHG: constant-current charge at 10A until pack voltage reaches vmax (4.2V).

Label: ChargeTaper
Comment: CV_CHG: hold at vmax (4.2V), taper off until current drops to 0.5A.

Label: Rest1
Comment: PAU: 30-minute rest after charge. PAU forbids comparison operators - value is plain '30 min'. Blank Action is fine here; the operator-level STO at the end still terminates the program.

Label: Discharge
Comment: CC_DCHG: constant-current discharge at 10A until pack voltage falls to vmin (3.0V).

Label: Rest2
Comment: PAU: 15-minute rest after discharge, before the recharge check.

Label: Recharge
Comment: CC_RECHG (opcode 21, BM Program v3.2 / Q10): a lighter top-up charge at 5A, separate from the main Charge step, up to 4.1V.

Label: RechargeTaper
Comment: CV_CHG: hold the recharge at 4.1V, taper until current drops to 0.1A.

Label: FinalLog
Comment: REG: re-asserts the Standard for the final capture. Nominal is an optional <=8-char grouping label only (never sent to the device) - left blank here. With no Registrations of its own it would inherit the nearest preceding SET, but it's set explicitly for clarity.

Label: End
Comment: STO: terminates the program. Pinned as the last step by the editor's own rules.
